analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($467.45) vs SMA5/20/50 ($510.68/$546.96/$567.28) — Below moving averages, indicating short-to-medium term downtrend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($484.06)/SMA200 ($400.25) — Confirms strength of the medium-to-long term downtrend.
· 52-week position (55.5%) + Current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.2 → 33.4) — Entered oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (previous -5.2712 → current -8.8738) — Bearish expansion, signaling continuation of the downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $483.97) — Approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($326.76) — Far from current price, indicating weak short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($533.74) — Far from current price, breakthrough could signal trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low formed) — Confirms continuation of the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.71x) — Low volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — Bearish pressure dominates due to oversold RSI and MACD bearish expansion; maintain observation.
